text:
nicole: Heads-up I opened a docs PR that bundles a few observability fixes: dashboard metric rename, cost/latency widget tweak, and a Ruby SDK tracehook example that was missing. Need quick reviews because a partner sandbox demo depends on this. :pray:

peter: link? saw some blank panels in the preview.

nicole: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6012 
summary: 1) replace legacy `latency_ms` with `p50_latency_ms` and surface `p95_latency_ms` as extra_series; 2) update the cost/latency breakdown sample to include token-cost annotations in the metric tooltip; 3) add Ruby snippet for TraceHook and rename param `trace_id_header` -> `trace_key_header`; 4) fix YAML anchors that broke the playground importer.

alesha: can you paste the before/after for the cost widget and the new Ruby snippet? makes review faster.

nicole: sure. cost widget old:```yaml
- type: stat
  label: avg_latency
  metric: avg(latency_ms{service="console"})
  description: Average latency in ms
```

new cost+latency widget:```yaml
- type: stat
  label: avg_p50_latency
  metric: avg(p50_latency_ms{service="console"})
  description: Median latency. Tooltip: "Cost estimate: $0.0007 / 1k tokens — approximate. Use batching to reduce per-token cost."  # token-cost note
  annotations:
    token_cost: 0.0007
    recommend_batching: true
```

nicole: Ruby tracehook snippet old->new:```ruby
# old (broken)
TraceHook.new(header: 'x-rw-trace', trace_id_header: 'x-rw-trace')
# new
TraceHook.new(header: 'x-rw-trace', trace_key_header: 'x-rw-trace-key')
# note: trace_id_header accepted for now but deprecated; please migrate to trace_key_header
```

david: nice. The breadcrumb about token cost is new — did we validate the value? which rate is that reflecting?

nicole: it's an approximate placeholder that points to /docs/pricing/token-metrics. I added a note in the PR description that teams should replace it with their own cost model if they use the example.

peter: I noticed the playground importer was choking on YAML anchors in the dashboard examples (anchors used to reuse panel fragments). Could you inline them or fix the anchors? The preview renderer doesn't resolve complex anchors.

nicole: good catch. I replaced anchors with explicit blocks for the affected panels to be stable in the importer. Left a comment explaining why we avoid anchors in examples.

alesha: also spotted a lint warning in the PR: fenced code block language tags missing in a couple of examples (makes syntax highlighting inconsistent). Tiny fix.

nicole: fixed the fences and pushed.

infra-bot: infra-note: queued a docs scan job to flag legacy metric name patterns matching `/\b[a-z]+_?ms\b/` across the examples repo. Will post findings in #eng-infra tomorrow.

peter: do we want to show both p50 and p95 in the main example? my vote: show p50, include p95 as an extra_series with a short sentence explaining tradeoffs. Folks in ops need to know tail behavior though.

david: agree. Add one line in the guide: "p50 represents typical latency; p95 surfaces tail latency — include p95 when troubleshooting spikes."

nicole: added that one-liner and a short troubleshooting section: "If panels are blank, confirm your exporter emits p50/p95 metrics; check for YAML anchors causing import failures."

alesha: smallest nit: the Ruby snippet uses `trace_key_header` camelCase vs snake_case in other languages; keep naming consistent with other SDK docs (`trace_key_header`).

nicole: updated Ruby param to `trace_key_header` (snake_case). Also added a test snippet for the playground importer in the PR (simple panel file) to prevent regressions.

docs-bot: CI: initial linkcheck flagged /console/observability/old-latency-guide -> 404; linter flagged deprecated-field `latency_ms` in examples/dashboard_examples.yaml.

nicole: added a redirect note in the PR for infra to land post-merge. Replaced one external blog link that returned 410 with /docs/perf/primer.

peter: reviewed, left two nits (fence language + a tooltip wording suggestion).

alesha: reviewed and approved. :+1:

infra-bot: redirect ticket created: /console/observability/old-latency-guide -> /console/observability/latency-quantiles (to be applied after site deploy).

docs-bot: PR merged by nicole (docs CI: success)  site deploy scheduled for 2026-04-22 03:45 UTC

nicole: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with infra to land the redirect after deploy and open a small tracking issue to replace the token cost placeholder with auto-populated values in future. Closing thread. :tada:
